newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Casablanca Bourse closes lower but gains over week.
newsitem.headline: Casablanca Bourse closes lower but gains over week.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Friday 0.24 percent lower, with ONA group and the banking sector registering lower values from Thursday's session, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 466.28 from 467.41 points on Thursday. Last Friday the index closed at 451.90 points.
ONA group, the country's largest conglomerate, which had been rising for two weeks, closed at 570 dirhams from 541 dirhams last Friday but down 20 from Thursday's figure.
Morocco's second largest conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement closed at 565 dirhams from 550 dirhams last week.
Wafabank, a liquid stock which recently merged with Spanish Uniban bank, closed at 570 dirhams from 550 dirhams the previous week.
Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce Exterieur traded at 430 dirhams from 405 dirhams last week.
Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique fell five dirhams on Friday to 145 dirhams from its last trading figure on January 6.

Credit firm Eqdom Credit, which said on Thursday it had increased it capital by more than 50.3 percent to 167.02 million dirhams ($18.9 million), was up 26 dirhams to close at 883 dirhams. Last week it closed at 762 dirhams.
Samir refinery shed 10 dirhams to close at 233 dirhams from 243 the week before.
Traded volume on the official market was 25.6 million dirhams from 35.4 million last Friday.
